question: A megabyte (MB) consists of 1024 ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__*​*Kilobytes__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A Megabyte (MB)** is a unit of digital information storage or transmission with the prefix mega, denoting multiplication by** one million in decimal and by 1024 in binary.**
 
• The unit symbol for the **Megabyte is MB.**
 
• One megabyte is equal to **1024 kilobytes (KB).**
 
• This is based on the binary system of data storage used in computing.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Gigabytes
 One gigabyte (GB) is 1024 megabytes (MB).
 
 

 Terabytes
 One terabyte (TB) is 1024 gigabytes (GB).
 
 

 Bytes
 A byte is the basic unit of information storage and transmission in digital systems. One kilobyte (KB) is 1024 bytes.
